name: Dial for Hookup
source:
A short VN dating sim where you play as a cool dog who needs to figure out which one of their awesome friends to hook up with! Based on Dial for Love, a shitty old flash game I used to play as a kid, which is where all the sounds in the game are taken from. There's no explicit sex or nudity in this one, sorry, but heavy sexual themes. Use your imagination. 😉

[from [url=https://tigertails.itch.io/dial-for-hookup]itch.io[/url]]
